scope: Automatic NPC/player rifle comparison, native/zero shot-cost phases and native guard Attack against a detected hostile NPC. The target health is initialized before measurement; no direct Damage or Explode call is used. Holster/firing, actual health, baseline AI and attack requests are separate observations. Player position/equipment and shot cost are restored. No user/computer-use input or acceptance-gate change.
